AI conversation is temporarily unavailable. Here are the glossary entries that match your question:

Bulk Fermentation: The fermentation stage after mixing and before dividing or shaping, when the dough rests as one mass. Gas builds while dough handling and fermentation develop its structure and flavor.
https://crust-and-crumb-tawny.vercel.app/term/bulk-fermentation

Fermentation: The biological process where yeast and bacteria consume sugars in the dough and produce carbon dioxide (which makes the bread rise), alcohol, and organic acids (which create flavor).
https://crust-and-crumb-tawny.vercel.app/term/fermentation
